top.para: Algarve Evolution's mapping of services, mentors and investors as a public matchmaking site: four parts, no server, consent before publication, free listings and pay per contact, with a prototype of invented people.

in-short.para: The mapping exists; matchmaking is luck; a public site; four parts; consent first; pay per use; a prototype.

done.para: Algarve Evolution mapped the region's service providers, talent, mentors and investors by hand: a warm first batch.

luck.para: Founders, investors, mentors and service providers need one place in the middle, and Algarve Evolution already sits there.

architecture.para: A web version of the spreadsheet: the spreadsheet, a Workspace mailbox, a Claude session and GitHub Pages; no server, no database, open source.

consent.para: Simulated site first, a preview to each person, publish only those who approve with the date kept, withdraw any time; our team listed first.

money.para: Free to list, browse and post; visitors pay a little per contact from credit after seeing the profile; no subscriptions.

prototype.para: Fourteen invented people and four needs: search, filters, profiles, a needs board, a post form, a credit meter and the consent screen.

build.line: How Algarve Evolution's team can build it
build.para: Set up the four parts, give a session this article and the prototype, simulate first, preview from the spreadsheet, publish approved rows, iterate.

limits.para: A proposal and prototype with invented data; António's words not yet quoted; not legal advice; approximate prices; my interest.

sources.para: My voice memo of 31 October and the prototype built for this article.
